question: Which certifications do entry-level cybersecurity jobs mention?
sources:
[1] Associate Cybersecurity Engineer at GM Financial (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-18)
Cybersecurity related Certifications strongly preferred

[2] DevSecOps Quality Assurance Engineer at FPT Software (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-11)
Prior cybersecurity experience and cybersecurity certifications such as Security+, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate is an advantage.

[3] Workflow Coordinator – Cyber at DMI (Digital Management, LLC) (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-18)
Required And Desired Skills/Certifications
Ideal Candidate: Project Management Professional, Certified Scrum Master, or PMI-ACP certified professional with significant cybersecurity program management expertise.
Skills: Must be a certified Agile project management professional with commensurate experience in a technical enterprise setting, experience tracking tasks across various platforms is required.
Certifications: Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP, PMP, Certified Scrum Master (CSM),) PMI-ACP, SAFe Agile

[4] Information Security Analyst at Infojini Inc (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-15)
Completion of one of the following recognized professional certifications: QSA (Qualified Security Assessor), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)Education:Degree: B.A./B.S.

[5] FedRAMP Cloud Cybersecurity Analyst at ASRC Federal (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-19)
Certificaiton(s)
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I requirements prior to onboarding e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher-level certification
Multiple cloud certifications preferred.
